title: 1998 remote viewing of the world's future to 2050

tellings.quote: back in 1998 I was tasked with um viewing the future of the US. it wound up I viewed the future of the world uh up through the year 2050

plain: In 1998, a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says, he was given the job of using remote viewing, a practice of trying to perceive distant places or times with the mind alone, to look at the future of the United States. He tells Michels that the session grew into a view of the whole world's future, all the way up to the year 2050. If true, it would mean a trained viewer was asked to look decades ahead, and says he did.
